name: West Virginia
agencyName: West Virginia Division of Motor Vehicles

examVariants.label: Level 1 instruction permit knowledge test (Class E)

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: You may retest; a test fee applies on each attempt

gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 50 hours (10 at night); waived by completing an approved driver education course
gdl.nightCurfew: Level 1: drive only 5 a.m.-10 p.m.; Level 2: no driving 10 p.m.-5 a.m. (with exceptions)
gdl.passengerLimits: Level 2: no passengers under 20 (other than family) for the first 6 months, then no more than one

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity (e.g. certified U.S. birth certificate or valid U.S. passport)
Two proofs of West Virginia residency
process.realIdNotes: A West Virginia REAL ID (gold star) requires one proof of identity, one proof of Social Security number, and two proofs of West Virginia residency, plus proof of any legal name change. A $10 surcharge applies the first time you obtain a REAL ID.
process.licenseFee: $40 for a 5-year Class E driver's license; verify current fee with DMV
process.visionStandard: At least 20/40 in one or both eyes, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 12 points in a 2-year period triggers a 30-day suspension; higher totals mean longer suspensions
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane or slow down for stopped emergency, tow, and utility vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 15 mph in a school zone when lights are flashing or children are present
